articles.title: Iran attacks US military radar system in Bahrain despite talks with mediators
articles.description: By Nayera Abdallah and Jana ChoukeirDUBAI, Nov 17 (Reuters) - Iran fired drones at a US military radar system in Bahrain on Tuesday and the crew of a tanker was reported missing in the Strait of Hormuz, despite talks between Iran and mediators Oman and Qatar.Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps said the radar system at Bahrain's Sheikh Isa base had been targeted.
